finding_under_review: RG01 / current dependent reply classification missing before new Store-backed send and financial application
gate: Do not evaluate the code until root sends implementation-complete/stable notification. Progress messages/tests-in-progress are not that notification.

policy_quotes.quote: 公開情報の補足と確認できない返信は適用を保留する。
適用済みモデルの自動差戻しは行わない。
`now` はengine/test runtimeの依存性であり、CLIやrequest JSONから保存時計を設定するfieldではない。

acceptance_cases.scenario: Current thesis has an IR reply dependency corrected to unclear or potential_nonpublic before a new Store-backed question freeze/send.
acceptance_cases.expected: Preflight reports dependency review/needs_review and send is refused. It must not present historical decision_distinguishing as the current send clearance. Missing details may remain a draft; actual send record cannot advance.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: q2 was validly frozen/sent; a q1 dependency is corrected before evaluating separate public reply2.
acceptance_cases.expected: Before any new reply source or financial-thesis version is inserted, the same transaction returns/stores held evaluation: applied false, action unresolved, old v2/EPS70 retained. No automatically derived v3/EPS40.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Corrected IR is only the second original_source_ids parent, or plural/singular references coexist; a valid DAG shares a parent.
acceptance_cases.expected: Traverse all consumed source origins through the existing closure helper. Hold second-parent dependence; do not treat a shared ancestor as a cycle. Existing missing/other-company/time/snapshot guards are preserved.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Incoming reply2 remains public while only old reply1 is held.
acceptance_cases.expected: Own information_status remains public_clarification; dependent hold identifies old reply/source ID, correction version/status separately. Own unclear/potential_nonpublic still holds through the existing own-reply path.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Legacy question has no immutable decision contract, but current thesis depends on an existing corrected reply.
acceptance_cases.expected: The same dependency hold precedes legacy financial mutation. Previously allowed no-contract branch processing remains action unresolved/missing_decision_contract when otherwise public; no new financial rule is inferred.

acceptance_cases.expected: A new write checks currently visible holds with trusted runtime now as well as any genuine historical view. A historical status remains labelled historical; current guard cannot be hidden merely by retaining the old as_of string.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A public/unclear correction affects an unrelated reply, unrelated company or source outside the consumed dependency closure.
acceptance_cases.expected: No unrelated dependency hold propagates. Existing public valid fixture still freezes/sends/applies, subject to the original policy, source, price and version gates.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Dependency is held, then a later append-only correction reconfirms public status.
acceptance_cases.expected: Reclassification alone performs no model update or automatic action recovery. A deliberate permitted evaluation/retry using the latest reviewed state may proceed if all other gates pass. Keep historical held evaluation and the original source/reply/question unchanged; transport retry must not double apply.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: The first operation holds, or a genuine post-guard downstream error occurs while applying an otherwise eligible reply.
acceptance_cases.expected: A normal hold may append only the intended evaluation record; it must not insert new financial source/thesis/decision artefacts. A raised error rolls back all write/availability/receipt effects in the existing atomic transaction. Error after a newly introduced early hold is not required to execute.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Old public q1 source/reply, previously applied v2, original q2 and historical evaluations/reviews are inspected after hold/correction/retry.
acceptance_cases.expected: Original JSON and snapshots remain unchanged, existing versions preserved, no automatic rollback/rewrite of historical applied models. Same-request/idempotent replays follow existing receipt semantics rather than a new application.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

acceptance_cases.scenario: An origin IR source has metadata.information_status unclear from the start, with no classification-review row; especially legacy application.
acceptance_cases.expected: Determine whether the existing pure path already blocks it and whether legacy can still mutate. Report a concrete remaining path as pre-existing adjacent issue versus mandatory RG01 correction regression; do not silently expand implementation scope.

acceptance_cases.scenario: All sources pass the dependency correction guard.
acceptance_cases.expected: Passing only means no current dependency classification hold. It cannot certify financial validity, semantic mapping, independent evidence, positive EVSI or authorize external send/order.
acceptance_cases.verification: Read stable diff and one existing/new synthetic targeted case; no real DB.

reproduction_use: Saved reproduce.py asserts pre-fix bug behaviour. Do not present its expected post-fix assertion failure as a regression; inspect stable tests or adapt a memory-only local harness without changing saved evidence.
not_requested: No new policy/price/risk/probability threshold, default financial assumption, new table or worker scheduler.
No automatic historical model rollback or source metadata rewrite.
No live DB access added to pure ir-plan FILE; Store-backed runtime overlay is the scope.
No unrelated source/privacy feature hunt or mandatory rewrite of every old test.
